methodology: Three alternating A/B pairs per workload. Elapsed time covers challenge send through complete serialized proof receipt. Every complete serialized proof independently verifies, and the same proof at an incorrect iteration count must fail. Synthetic loopback workload, not a mainnet or 24-hour result. Fixed discriminants from hw_test; private GMP with HGCD2_DIV2_METHOD=1.
decision: Retain opt-in threshold; recommend 500K for the measured regular three-engine workload. Repeated balanced gains are 13.83%,7.67%,2.43% at 1M,2M,4M; longer proofs nearly flat. Irregular requests are mostly flat (250K -0.04%, 1M -0.08%, 2M -0.32%, 4M +1.88%, 20M +0.11%), with a 1.02% loss at 100K. 100K checkpoints produce stronger regular gains but a 3.69% irregular 250K regression. Fixed k and value-spacing candidates rejected.

clean_implementation_validation.notes: Small sample, short-proofs noisy; primary retained 500K results were measured directly on the cleaned CLI implementation.

cli_parser_validation: Reject empty, negative, whitespace-prefixed, plus-prefixed, trailing garbage, below-8000 and overflow values. Accept 8000,100000,500000,1000000,UINT32_MAX. Hardware-free readiness test passes.
